findings.title: Skip-restart deviation: W1 work executed in W0-tagged session (operator-arbitrated)
findings.detail: After W0 close, the canonical protocol step is: update .claude/settings.json AHO_WORKSTREAM W0→W1, then operator runs `claude --continue` to restart the session so the new env value flows into OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES. Operator (Kyle) directive 'skip restart i need the base container in the next 2 hours' arbitrated proceeding without restart to meet the 2-hour ship window. Consequence: claude-code's own OTEL emissions during W1 work (Bash tool spans, cost.usage metrics, etc.) carry aho.workstream=W0 in resource attrs. Aho-emitted structured events (workstream_start, this acceptance archive, future workstream_complete) correctly carry workstream='W1' as event-content attribution. Cost-attribution per Pillar 8 will incorrectly land W1 spend on W0 for this session — recoverable via post-hoc reconciliation of session start/end timestamps if needed. Materiality (ADR-0010) unaffected — it counts audit cycles by content, not span tags. Pattern: future workstreams that change inside an active session should default to restart unless an explicit time-pressure arbitration is recorded.

findings.title: Version-string drift across 5 source locations, no single source of truth
findings.detail: W1 recon found aho version strings drifted across 5 independent locations: pyproject.toml (0.2.14 → 0.2.18), src/aho/__init__.py (0.1.0 → 0.2.18 — never updated since 0.1.0), src/aho/health.py (0.2.17 → 0.2.18), src/aho/cli.py:9 VERSION (0.2.14 → 0.2.18), and Dockerfile LABEL block (0.2.17 → 0.2.18). cli.py:112 'aho_version: 0.1' is unrelated (it's the .aho.json schema version). The drift pattern means past iteration-close rituals have not consistently bumped every string. Plan-doc §W1 said 'aho package version bumped to 0.2.18 in source' (singular), masking the actual scope. Recommended structural fix (carry-forward): consolidate to single source via importlib.metadata.version('aho') read in __init__.py + cli.py + health.py so future iterations only need to bump pyproject.toml. Defer the refactor to a maintenance workstream — W1 deliverable here is just the bump.

findings.title: Substrate drift discovered post-W1-close: tailnet re-keyed + a8 host rebuilt → v1 image FQDN stale
findings.detail: W2 pre-flight reachability probes uncovered three substrate-level changes since the W0 a8geekomCos probe (probe was ~7 days prior): (1) Tailnet domain rolled from `tail78a311.ts.net` -> `tail8492.ts.net` (Tailscale-side re-key/migration); (2) a8 short name changed from `a8geekomcos` -> `a8cos`; (3) a8 Tailscale IP changed `100.74.161.116` -> `100.124.234.113`; (4) a8 SSH ed25519 host key fingerprint changed from `SHA256:8u4F8JRWIbu3AXE8x5vzDtgQ7U1YGwQcS7W8P5IogNs` -> `SHA256:hKOJnbihqRQB0jpGLzNW0xaB/1Xdlhm2V4oVqf80gmg`. The host-key change confirms a8 was rebuilt (OS reinstall or replacement), not just renamed at the Tailscale layer. Consequence: the v1 W1 image (digest sha256:46ef5a13...) baked `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://nzxtcos.tail78a311.ts.net:4317` which a8cos can no longer resolve. Rebuild executed in-session with corrected FQDN `nzxtcos.tail8492.ts.net`; new image digest sha256:9f6b5844d365...; smoke re-verified (OTEL endpoint env reads new value, aho --version unchanged at 0.2.18). v1 image was never pushed to ghcr.io, so the supersede is cost-free. Pattern: substrate-fact captures in probe artifacts (tailnet domain, IPs, hostnames, host keys) decay rapidly and must be re-verified at consumption time, not trusted from probe age. Same convention input as F-0.2.18-W0-003 (test-file-existence) and F-0.2.18-W1-003 — recurring shape: 'artifact references a substrate fact that has drifted since capture'.

findings.title: W2 prep work (collector rebind + ufw rules) executed in W1 session
findings.detail: Per plan-doc, the OTEL collector rebind from 127.0.0.1:4317 to the Tailscale interface and the corresponding ufw allow-in rules belong to W2 D1. Operator directive 'let's also make sure the required ports open with ufw and fix dns before rebuilding image' arbitrated landing these in the W1 session as pre-flight for the W1 image rebuild + W2 launch. Substantive changes: (a) /home/kthompson/.config/aho/otel-collector.yaml lines 5+7 changed from 127.0.0.1:4317/4318 to 0.0.0.0:4317/4318 (new sha256 ea30631e305d46005aebbaebdd077104b12104212e24dc7fbeee09359b773df0); (b) aho-otel-collector.service user-systemd restart picked up new bind (verified via ss -tlnp showing *:4317 + *:4318); (c) operator added ufw rules on NZXTcos: 4317/tcp + 4318/tcp ALLOW IN on tailscale0 (both v4 + v6); (d) a8cos egress is default-allow per a8cos ufw status — no rule additions needed there. End-to-end verification: bash /dev/tcp probe from a8cos to nzxtcos:4317 and :4318 returned OPEN for both FQDN and IP after the changes. Same attribution-gap shape as F-0.2.18-W1-001 — these W2-flavored changes carry aho.workstream=W0 in this session's claude-code OTEL resource attrs, while content-side attribution remains correct.
